learning_outcomes.text: Students gain insights into future professional activities, operational working methods, and social structures.
Students learn testing, design, and development methods, as well as procedural and operational tasks in IT security.
Students become familiar with communicative and social key qualifications from interacting with supervisors and team members.

syllabus_topics: Autonomous search for an internship position with activities in IT security.
Registration before the start of the internship via the computer science examination office.
Execution of the internship with documentation of activities.
Submission of a report (documentation of activities).
assessment_rules: Credits are awarded for a successfully completed internship and a positively evaluated submitted documentation. The internship is ungraded.
